exercises.why: **красивая** — краси́вый: beautiful, handsome; (ironic) fine, admirable, noble. Wiktionary: краса́ + -и́вый.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ленив** — лени́вый: lazy (unwilling to work). Wiktionary: лень + -и́вый.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **ворчли́вый** — grumpy, grouchy. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-лив», meaning 1 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-лив).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: краси́вый — beautiful, handsome; лени́вый — lazy (unwilling to work); льсти́вый — flattering, sycophantic; правди́вый — true, truthful.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **очарова́тельный** — charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating. Source: Wiktionary, «-тельный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тельный#Russian).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ворчли́вый — grumpy, grouchy; забо́тливый — thoughtful, caring, considerate, solicitous; пугли́вый — timid, fearful; очарова́тельный — charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating.
**очарователен** — очарова́тельный: charming, enchanting, adorable, lovely, fascinating. Wiktionary: очарова́ть + -тельный.
